_instructions.how_to_add_an_article: Copy one of the article objects below, paste it at the TOP of the articles array (newest first), and fill in your details. The site will automatically show the 6 most recent.
_instructions.image: Optional. Use the LinkedIn article cover image URL, or host an image in your assets/ folder and reference it as 'assets/your-image.jpg'. If omitted, a placeholder will show.

articles.title: Leadership is a two-way street — and most managers miss the second half
articles.excerpt: Everyone talks about earning the trust of your engineers. Almost nobody talks about what it means to extend trust back — and why that's the harder, more important half of the equation.

articles.title: Why I was in every incident situation room — even when I wasn't needed
articles.excerpt: I made a personal commitment early in my management career: no incident situation room involving my team happened without me present. Here's what that taught me about what leadership actually means under pressure.
